title: Past the teacher
goals: Reach the way out at the top.
Do not let the teacher see you.
starting_code:
# The teacher walks up and down the corridor, looking ahead.
# Wait while they look your way, then cross.
wizard.wait()
hints: Watch which way the teacher looks as they walk.
`wizard.wait()` lets one tick go by while you stay hidden.
A `while` loop can keep waiting while `teacher.facing` is `"left"`.
